corrections.authorization: User requested fixing the xblc error in the runnable Stata copy.
corrections.scope: Four fixed-profile plotting calls; estimation and PIF commands unchanged.

analysis_replacements.original:
levelsof bmi, local(bmi_levels)

xblc `vlist_bmi', ///
    covname(bmi) at(`bmi_levels') reference(40) eform ///
    generate(bmi_x bmi_or bmi_lb bmi_ub) pr
analysis_replacements.replacement:
obesity_spline_profile `vlist_bmi', ///
    covname(bmi) generate(bmi_x bmi_or bmi_lb bmi_ub)

analysis_replacements.original:
levelsof age_at_encounter, local(age_levels)

xblc `vlist_age', ///
    covname(age_at_encounter) at(`age_levels') reference(60) eform ///
    generate(age_x age_or age_lb age_ub) pr
analysis_replacements.replacement:
obesity_spline_profile `vlist_age', ///
    covname(age_at_encounter) generate(age_x age_or age_lb age_ub)
